summary.zh-CN: 多功能 AI 代理，支持研究、图像生成、视频、音频、音乐、播客、虚拟形象、声音克隆等多种内容创建能力。用于媒体内容生成和智能分析。

conditions.en: Cannot be added: this skill works only through CellCog's official Python SDK (the cellcog pip package); the skill text documents no HTTP interface that can be called directly, and files are uploaded through the SDK. Teloa skills cannot install or run Python packages or scripts.
